subject: The secret mistake 92% of couples make on dates
preview_text: I only share this with actual users - not on social media. This changes how you plan everything.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I've been watching how couples use SoulPlan for months now. And I noticed something that made me pause. Most people think the magic happens during the date itself. They're wrong. The real spark? It happens in the 48 hours BEFORE.

I was analyzing our most successful couples - the ones who said SoulPlan 'improved their relationship' - and found their secret. They don't just pick a date idea and show up. They use the planning phase as foreplay. The anticipation, the little hints, the shared excitement while building the date together - that's where the connection deepens. I've never shared this publicly because honestly? Most people wouldn't get it. But you're actually using the app, so you will.

That's why the Shared Wishlist feature exists, but hardly anyone uses it right. It's not just a list of ideas. It's a conversation starter, a way to drop hints about what you really want, a place to build anticipation together. The couples who get this? They're planning dates that feel like Christmas morning because they've been unwrapping the excitement for days.

Open SoulPlan right now and add just ONE thing to your Shared Wishlist. Not a generic 'dinner date' - something specific that makes your partner's eyes light up. Watch what happens when they see it. P.S. The couples who do this? They report 3x more 'spark' moments. Don't be in the 92% who miss this.
